text: How does Simplicial TT relate to HoTT?
choices: HoTT is the subtheory of Simplicial TT where all types are Rezk groupoids (invertible morphisms)
HoTT and Simplicial TT have incompatible semantics
explanation: Simplicial TT extends HoTT: setting all morphisms invertible (groupoid condition) recovers HoTT.
